notes.title: Mauled is Back with a Major New Update!
notes.content:
[h2]After some time away, I am thrilled to announce the return of Mauled with a major update![/h2]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Cyrofrost Map: Explore an abandoned mountain base now overrun with zombies. (Map is in Beta; I invite you to test and report any issues to my private [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/umYn6J56bz]Discord[/url])
[*] Dynamic day-night cycle for Cyrofrost level.
[*] New Character Nova: A new hero joins the fight
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1599410/extras/Gameplay4__1_.png?t=1697983452[/img]

[h3]New Enemies in Cyrofrost:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Runner Zombie
[*] Ghoul
[*] Kamikaze Zombie
[*] Tank Zombie
[*] Zombie Boss
[/list]

[h3]Technical Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved overall fps
[*] Optimized lighting mass
[*] Refined ambient occlusion
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[b]Working solo[/b] means a significant workload, but passion drives me to continually enhance the game. [b]We plan major updates every 1 to 2 months[/b] with new maps, enemies, weapons, characters, and much more. Thank you all for your continued support!

The game has already reached over [b]8k downloads[/b] and I aim to grow even more. Remember, your opinion is invaluable; please [b]leave a review[/b] if you enjoyed the game!

Mauled will remain [b]Free To Play[/b]. The only source of income will be purely cosmetic in-game purchases.

More updates coming soon! Join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/umYn6J56bz]Discord[/url] community to stay updated.

notes.title: Important new updates!!!
notes.content:
I had taken a break. I went through all the reviews, even the not-so-nice ones, and tried to improve things a little bit:

- all characters are available to everyone. So there are no more in-game purchases. For now. 

- this is important. The levels are still procedural, but the size was reduced otherwise the player would get lost and take a long time to find and kill all the enemies.

- I cleaned up the hud, it was too messy sorry I'm a minimalist.

- i changed the scenery of the levels a bit, making them more pleasant (many complained that the levels were confusing, now they are a bit less so, or at least i hope so).

- melee is less glitchy than before but still working on it.

- if you have any advice for me to improve this game you can find me on discord i recently created a channel [url=https://discord.gg/umYn6J56bz]https://discord.gg/umYn6J56bz[/url] :) For those who don't know the game was developed and is maintained only by myself so in short, I hope there are not too many bugs.
